title: Reachability under an invariant
statement: Let $A$ be a program, let an oracle assign a Boolean answer to each decider and bit string, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. A configuration $a'$ is reachable from $a$ in some finite number $T$ of steps if the run from $a$ on $x$ reaches $a'$ at time $T$ and every configuration at a time $t<T$ satisfies $G$.
hypotheses_covered: oracle on deciders and bit strings
